structured.finding: The post-loop `raise RuntimeError(msg)` is meant to stop the method returning None if the retry loop ever finishes without a result. That can't happen: each attempt returns or raises, and an exhausted loop raises, so nothing reaches the line.
structured.reason: Every attempt either returns `adapter.execute(request)` straight away or raises. When retries run out, the retry loop raises, and the except block turns that error into the boundary error. So execution never gets past the loop, and the guard the mutant replaces with `pass` is never reached.
